name: Nutrient
summary: Document platform with PDF SDKs, cloud APIs and agent tools for extraction, conversion, OCR, redaction and eSignatures.
description: SDKs and cloud APIs for document work: extract structured data from PDFs, scans and Office files, convert between formats, OCR, generate, compare, redact, sign, and tag PDFs for accessibility (PDF/UA). Hosted APIs each have a free tier; self-hosted and air-gapped deployments are supported. An MCP server and skills let agents call the APIs, while workflow automation keeps approvals, audit trails and human review.
contains: cloud APIs (DWS) with a free tier per API; Data Extraction: 5,000 credits/month
SDKs for web, iOS, Android, React Native, .NET and server
MCP server plus skills: PDF-to-Markdown, Make PDF, Remediate PDF
capabilities: extraction, classification, conversion, OCR, generation, redaction, eSignatures, accessibility
workflow automation with confidence scores, approvals and human review
deploy hosted, self-hosted or air-gapped; use any AI model or none
